memory_action.description: Validated CVRP savings shortlist and normalized tie-break
memory_action.body:
## Execution
Use the verified skill from round 14. Rank by raw depot savings; within 2% of the maximum rerank by normalized savings minus a capacity-scaled demand penalty.

**Why:** It scored 11.06360 versus 12.11504 for the nearest-neighbor baseline and 11.11117 for the previous incumbent on this six-instance development suite.

**How to apply:** Preserve the primary absolute savings and use the secondary score only within the shortlist. Check the depot case, where raw savings all tie.

**Reusable Experience:** A bounded shortlist can expose more useful ranking changes than replacing the primary score wholesale. Improvements were mixed across instances and are not verified on heldout data.
